name: kognexus-nexus
description: Simulation proving networked-actuator behaviours on a flexible 6-DOF arm.

scripts.check: npm run check:rust && npm run build:wasm && npm run check:ts && npm run check:py
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --quiet
scripts.check:py: cd learning && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q
